ui_bugs.issue: Unbookmarking from the Shortlist page itself does not remove the card from the visible list until a manual reload. The BookmarkButton correctly calls DELETE /api/shortlist/{id} and updates the shared cache in useShortlist(), but Shortlist.jsx keeps its own local `items` state that is only populated in the initial useEffect(load, []). It never subscribes to shortlist cache changes, so the deleted card stays rendered.

action_items: Fix Shortlist.jsx to react to shortlist cache changes: either subscribe to the useShortlist() cache (e.g., re-derive items from `cache` or re-call load() when isSaved(id) flips false), or filter local items when the id is no longer saved. Suggested minimal fix: after toggle, either optimistically remove from local items or call load() from a listener.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stream_llm imports emergentintegrations symbols TextDelta/StreamDone at call time; if the SDK is missing or changes signature, only stream endpoint breaks — consider moving to module top-level to fail fast on startup instead of on first request.

assistant_chat: DB write of the assistant turn happens AFTER the entire stream finishes (`await db.assistant_history.insert_one` in gen() finally-like tail). If the client disconnects mid-stream (user navigates away), the assistant message is never persisted while the user turn is — will yield lopsided history. Consider writing partial content on cancel.
Shortlist.jsx uses two sources of truth (local items[] and useShortlist() cache) — this is the direct cause of the stale-state UI bug reported above. Consolidate.
Studio.jsx uses raw fetch() so X-Client-Id from axios interceptor is bypassed; header is manually attached — works, but a common gotcha for future streaming endpoints.
auth_google.py build_router.google_login: `httpx.QueryParams({k: v})[k]` is an unusual way to URL-encode. Prefer httpx.QueryParams(params) or urllib.parse.urlencode for readability.
test_credentials: No auth-gated features tested (Google OAuth is intentionally unconfigured — fallback path only). test_credentials.md is empty; not required for this iteration.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use TEST_-prefixed X-Client-Id UUIDs for shortlist isolation (auto-cleaned by test teardown). LLM cache for opp-1 idea-lab is now populated with a regenerated version (subsequent regen calls will still work because they bust cache).
